title: MusicDrop v1.7.5 — Fix TV Hardware Auto-Routing, Remote Control & Screen Sizing
changelog:
• Automatic TV Detection & Routing: Comprehensive multi-layer detection for Android TV, Google TV, Fire TV, Mi Box, and generic Android TV boxes, instantly launching the dedicated TV Experience without getting stuck in mobile mode
• 100% TV Remote Control Navigation: All HUD controls (Play/Pause, Next, Previous, Seek, Rewind, Fast Forward, Download, Like) fully navigable with TV remote D-Pad, OK, and media keys
• Fixed Speed Dial Card Sizing: Constrained card dimensions on landscape and TV displays so cards never take up the full screen or cause erratic scrolling
• One-Touch TV Mode Switch: High-visibility 'TV Mode' toggle in the top bar allows immediate switching to TV mode anytime
• Suppressed Mobile Player on TV: TV mode exclusively uses the high-performance native ExoPlayer overlay with no blank screens
